news.title: Australia’s Coalition pledges to scrap Temporary Graduate visas, cut student numbers
news.summary_en: If elected, the Coalition has vowed to abolish Temporary Graduate visas and cut international student commencements to 240,000 a year under a sweeping migration plan.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Mainland students fuel Hong Kong’s education boom
news.summary_en: More than half of Hong Kong’s higher education students are now from outside the territory, according to new British Council research, as the city accelerates efforts to strengthen its position as a regional education hub.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: In focus: How UK unis are staying under the 5% BCA threshold
news.summary_en: As institutions scramble to stay compliant under tightened BCA requirements, Spencer Withrington uncovers one of the ways universities are staying under the new 5% visa refusal threshold – and the cost it is having on students.
news.author: Spencer Withrington

news.title: Inside South Korea’s push to bring IB into mainstream schools
news.summary_en: Wilson Shang explores how South Korea has emerged as one of the world’s most prominent testbeds for embedding international curricula into mainstream state schooling.
news.author: Wilson Shang
